name: Kanom jeen
description: Fermented rice noodles served cold under curry, with a table of raw vegetables.

ayurveda.note: The ferment and curry are ushna.

unani.note: Outside the classical record; garam by ferment.

histamine.note: The noodles are fermented for days — that is what makes them kanom jeen.

nutrition.highlight: the noodles are the fermented part
